messages:
maria: Hey team, heads-up I'm planning parental leave starting 2026-10-04. Two quick asks: can someone confirm the deadline for uploading hospital docs so daycare subsidy and benefits continue, and is there a template for a coverage/backfill note I can share with hiring?

mira (People Ops): Congrats Maria! :tada: Practical timeline: upload proof (hospital form or placement docs) within 14 days of filing to avoid delays; payroll runs on a monthly cutoff so aim for 3 weeks before your start date for full processing. Coverage template: we have a short staffing note in the HR portal under "templates" you can copy, but quick checklist below:
- Expected leave start/end date
- Critical projects + owners
- On-call rotations or escalation lead
- Temporary access needs or contractor reqs

linda (Benefits): Daycare subsidy: enrollments are processed after the leave case is approved. If you want the subsidy to start immediately on your leave start date, upload the childcare enrollment form within 10 business days of filing. We can retro-pay one cycle if you miss it but it's extra admin. Lactation and workspace accommodations remain active; contact facilities for a private space key if needed.

dan: From hiring/coverage: we can open a 2-month contractor req if you prefer. Maria, can you mark which repo/admin keys to transfer temporarily? Also would help to have a 30-min overlap for knowledge transfer.

maria: I'll add a short keys list in the coverage box and schedule a 30-min handoff on 2026-09-27. About the daycare form  where in the portal is it exactly?

mira (People Ops): In the HR portal: Benefits -> Family Support -> Childcare Subsidy -> "Enroll dependent". Upload the subsidy form plus the same proof doc you used for leave (birth/adoption). If you need help attaching files, DM me and I can walk through it.

people-ops-bot: automated reminder: "Upload leave supporting docs and childcare enrollment to HR portal. Recommended deadline for full processing: 2026-09-12."

linda (Benefits): Quick note on partner coverage: if you are adding a partner to the plan, use the Dependents form and submit within 30 days of the event. If partner is already listed, no action needed. Also we offer a one-time childcare stipend for new parents to help with back-to-work care; request it via expenses -> category 'family-stipend'.

dan: I'll draft the contractor req and post a short coverage note template in the repo. Maria, if you want us to prioritize a specific project for the contractor, say so in the coverage box.

maria: Thanks all. Filing the portal request tonight and will ping Mira with the case number. Appreciate the help :heart:
